Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. (2026-09-19). Independent practitioner · Limited assurance. Pinnacle Verification Centre evidence summary. https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sae3000.html

original The report records limited assurance over its defined Statement of Institutional Claims using the Board-adopted criteria specified in the report. Limited assurance is different from reasonable assurance. Outcome-study figures, ratings and financial statements fall outside the described scope; the report does not independently validate clinical efficacy. Original source: Original seven-page SAE 3000 report; September handout physical p14 provides a secondary summary.
